title: TLS 1.3 record layer
summary: A TLS record consists of a 5-byte header (content type 1 byte, legacy version 2 bytes, length 2 bytes) followed by the (possibly encrypted) fragment. In TLS 1.3 the real content type moves into the encrypted payload (inner content type).

ext.summary: A TLS record consists of a 5-byte header (content type 1 byte, legacy version 2 bytes, length 2 bytes) followed by the (possibly encrypted) fragment. In TLS 1.3 the real content type moves into the encrypted payload (inner content type).

structure.meaning: Outer type: 0x17 application data (all TLS 1.3 records), or 0x14 change cipher spec, 0x15 alert, 0x16 handshake for legacy.

ext.example_decoded: Application data record, TLS 1.2 legacy version, 5-byte fragment 'Hello'
notes: TLS 1.3 encrypts the entire fragment including an inner content type byte and optional padding.
Record size limit 2^14+256 bytes; larger messages split across records.
TLS 1.3 removes compression and stream ciphers.
AEAD (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305) authenticates the header's AAD.
